## Summary

This PR adds a single agent-authored acceptance artifact whose internal honesty is genuinely excellent — signatures are refused rather than implied, absences are pinned to a SHA, deadlines fail closed. The concerns are almost entirely about packaging rather than content: the filename and PR title claim more than the pending signatures inside support, two load-bearing estimates carry no visible derivation, and the gate data the document itself says should be machine-readable (CR-019) is locked in prose tables. **Verdict: COMMENT** — nothing blocks merge structurally except the one-time repo-visibility check and a decision on how the artifact advertises its conditional state.

**What this PR actually is.** One added file, 526 lines, no code. Reviewing a document like this means reviewing its epistemics: what it claims, what it refuses to claim, and how it will be read by people and machines who never open it.

**The architectural through-line.** Nearly every finding is a variation on one theme: *the contents are more honest than the container.* Kubernetes learned this with KEPs (status frontmatter exists because docs get cited by path), and Google's Binary Authorization encodes the inverse of the same lesson this document gets right in prose — absence of attestation blocks, never infers. Prose cannot push back when cited by reference; data can. That makes the REFRAME finding (`gates-as-data-not-prose`) the highest-leverage comment here: emit the structured companion now, and the citability and CR-list-drift findings mostly dissolve at the root. The one pre-merge action that is not a judgment call: confirm repository visibility before a curated map of deployed auth posture lands (`auth-gap-enumeration-exposure`).

- **[Security] Fail-closed by construction.** 'Unknown/pending at deadline = No-go for T2' (U-1) plus the repeated do-not-invent annotations mean this artifact cannot be laundered into consent by silence. This is the property that makes agent-authored acceptance records viable at all — it is Binary Authorization's deny-by-default, hand-written. Carry it verbatim into the sibling ACCEPT-* artifacts.
- **[Test Coverage] Honest negative evidence.** Recording that vitest was *not* executed — instead of implying green — and enumerating absent symbols against pinned baseline `3782fd47` makes every absence claim replayable. Section 2.2 doubles as the CR-019 verification checklist at zero additional cost.
- **[Quality] Scope discipline under temptation.** The document repeatedly refuses adjacent look-alike surfaces (acvp-l1-v2 envelopes, RoleSnapshot, SERVICE_TOKEN posture) as substitutes for the missing collection-report contracts, and names the seed-vs-system confusion risk outright in its closing caveat. Refusing plausible substitutes is rarer and more valuable than the inventory itself.
- **[Operational] The header's conditional verdict** shows the author anticipated mis-citation before any reviewer did; the citability finding asks only that this self-awareness be hoisted from section 9 up to where path-level and automated readers will actually encounter it.
